summary: This bill requires the Commissioner of Social Security to conduct a 20-year demonstration project that modifies disability benefits for blind individuals by removing work-related eligibility restrictions and adjusting benefits based on earnings, rather than terminating them.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a demonstration project to modify disability benefits for blind individuals, allowing them to earn more income without losing benefits and removing disincentives to work. This expands access to benefits and makes them more flexible, which is a form of welfare expansion.
